capability: Write agent work as a short line of arrows
title: Draw the order as one line.

hook.picture: Close on the whale tossing work cards to three pods in whatever order it remembers. Two pods grab the same card.
hook.words: Just kick off all three agents.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: My agents ran in the wrong order and nobody could tell.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three nights of logs. Each night the pods start in a different order, faster each time, and the ✕ lands somewhere new.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The order lives only in your head.

stakes.body: Nights of runs wasted, and wrong answers built on half-finished steps.

solution_hint: Write the order down before anything runs.

metaphor.body: The whale writes the order as one short line of arrows. Pods line up along it, split where steps run side by side, and a gate checks the line before anything runs.

steps.picture: The whale writes a short line: three marks joined by arrows. The pods line up along it in that order.
The line splits. Two pods sit side by side and work at once, then the line rejoins after both tick.
steps.words: Side by side, when nothing waits on it.
steps.sound: Two taps in unison, then one.

steps.picture: Push-in: before any pod moves, a gate checks the line. A step that needs an answer not yet made is stopped. The whale moves it later.
steps.words: Wrong order? Stopped before it runs.
steps.sound: A stopped tap, then a clean one.

steps.picture: Pod one fails. The line takes its backup branch to a second pod, which answers ✓.
steps.sound: A miss, then a clean tap.

real_case.claim: Hekat's README example: a workflow with side-by-side steps finished in about 10 minutes and 75K tokens, against 30 minutes run one step at a time.

honest_limit.picture: Three backup pods share one wrong input card and all fail the same way. Backups only help when failures differ.
honest_limit.words: Backups fail together when they share a mistake.

not_this.body: Clear order is not a right answer.

ending_pattern.body: The whale tosses work exactly as in FELT, but the pods now follow the written arrow line, take turns, and all answer ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same three pods and tossing gesture as bar 1, with no grab and no early start.

end_belief.body: Write the order down. Let it check itself.

beats.picture: Close: the whale tosses work cards to three pods at once, in no fixed order.
beats.words: Just kick off all three agents.
beats.sound: Three loose taps, out of time.

beats.picture: Pod three starts before pod one has finished. Its answer card gets a raw sienna ✕ chip.
beats.words: Step three ran before step one finished.

beats.picture: Two pods grab the same card and pull.
The whale looks at the ✕. Hold.
beats.camera: Close z 1.7, hold on the whale's face

beats.picture: Half a bar of stillness, then the title.
beats.words: Draw the order as one line.
beats.camera: Still z 1.6, half bar of stillness

beats.picture: Pull back: three nights of logs stacked. Each night the pods start in a different order.
beats.words: The order lives only in your head.
beats.sound: Problem motif: taps out of step.

beats.picture: Three more nights flash by, every 2 beats, then 1, then half. The ✕ moves each time.
Motion stops. A faint line with arrows ghosts in under the pods.
beats.words: Write the order down before anything runs.
beats.sound: One clean, steady pulse: the signature.

beats.picture: The whale writes a short line: three marks joined by arrows. The pods line up along it in that order.
The line splits. Two pods sit side by side and work at once, then the line rejoins after both tick.
beats.words: Side by side, when nothing waits on it.
beats.sound: Two taps in unison, then one.

beats.picture: Push-in: before any pod moves, a gate checks the line. A step that needs an answer not yet made is stopped. The whale moves it later.
beats.words: Wrong order? Stopped before it runs.
beats.sound: A stopped tap, then a clean one.

beats.picture: Pod one fails. The line takes its backup branch to a second pod, which answers ✓.
beats.sound: A miss, then a clean tap.

beats.picture: Wide: the split line next to a long ghost line of the same steps run one by one. The split line finishes first.
beats.words: Same three steps, two side by side.

beats.picture: A chain of three backup pods. The first two answer ✕, the third ✓, and the line never breaks.
beats.words: If one fails, the backup tries next.

beats.picture: Three backup pods all read the same wrong card. All three answer ✕ in the same way, and the chain of backups does not help.
beats.words: Backups fail together when they share a mistake.

beats.picture: Slow push to the shared wrong card.
beats.camera: One slow push to the thing that slipped

beats.picture: FELT framing: the whale tosses work again, but now the pods follow the written line. No two grab the same card.
beats.camera: Close z 1.6, the FELT framing restored

beats.picture: Every pod answers ✓ in order. The whale sparks.
The short arrow line on the paper, the whale breathing.
beats.words: Write the order down. Let it check itself.

beats.picture: SERIES.lockup.

score_self.reason: Engineers know this pain. The arrow line is a clean picture and the limit (shared mistakes) is sharp. The case is a README example, not a measured run, and the card says so. Hekat is less 'art' than the rest of the cluster.
